tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// 'phags pa byams pa mgon po la bstod pa yid bzhin nor bu'i sprin phung zhes bya ba/ na maḥshrī ār+ya mai tri nā thā ya/ rgyal tshab rkang gnyis gtso bo lha yi lha// ma byon sangs rgyas byams chen skyob nyid la// rnam pa kun tu bdag blo mi phyed pa'i// dad pas phyag 'tshal rgyun tu bskyab par mdzod// ngo mtshar bsod nams ye shes rgya mtsho yi// bdag nyid pha rol phyin bcu mthar son pas// phal cher legs tshogs thub dbang dang mtshungs pa// sa bcu'i dbang phyug khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal sras thu bo rnams kyi pho brang mchog /theg chen longs spyod dga' ldan nyid bzhugs nas// sna tshogs chos kyi pho brang 'thug khrigs las// bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bebs khyod la= /shākya'i rgyal po mya ngan 'das gyur kyang*// de bstan rnam 'byed rin chen sgron 'dra ba'i// dri med gzhung lngas legs bshad rgyas mdzad pa// rgyal tshab chos rje khyod la= /rim gyis gau taṃ bstan ni mar ngo yi// zla ltar 'grib 'gyur tshe yang khyod sku dang*// gsung la dad bgyis slar yang gsal 'gyur ba// mi pham chos srid 'dzin la= /rab rgud skye bo lo bcur gyur pa na// rnam gsum sprul pas lam ngan las bzlog nas// rnam bcu dge la legs bkod bde mdzad pa// 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig khyod la= /thabs la mkhas pas sangs rgyas zhing sbyangs te// skal bzang skye bo brgyad khrir 'tsho ba'i tshe// 'dzam gling dbus 'dir bdud kyi sde bcom zhing*// rdzogs par byang chub mdzad la= /dri med 'phags lam yan lag brgyad ldan pa'i// chos kyi 'khor lo shin tu yongs bskor nas// dung phyur phrag mang mchog tshogs 'dus pa dang*// lhar bcas skye bo smin mdzad phyag 'tshal lo// mtshan mchog bzang ldan dpe byad brgyad cu'i sku// lta bas mi ngoms dzaṃ bu chu bo yi// gser ltar 'od gsal gzi brjid dpal 'tsher ba'i// yid 'phrog brjid pa khyod la=

/tshangs dbyangs 'brug sgra ltar snyan zab pa'i gsung*// theg chen lam ston rab tu dbugs 'byin cing*// thos pas mi ngoms bye ba phrag brgya yi// gling gnas skye bo tshim mdzad= /mkha' ltar dri med shel ltar dwangs ba'i thugs// rgya mtsho ri bo lta bur zab cing brtan// ji bzhin ji snyed rnam dag mkhyen pa yi// ye shes bsam mi khyab la= /thabs mkhas thugs rje'i phrin las lhun grub pas// rlabs chen cho 'phrul gsum gyis skal ba bzhin// ma lus gdul bya 'dul smin grol mdzad cing*// yun ring bstan pa la gnas= /de ltar 'gro mgon rkang gnyis gtso bo khyod// sa steng kun tu sna tshogs skur ston cing*// khyad par byang phyogs gangs can sa yi char// rigs ldan don grub mdzad la= /rab mdzes seng khri rgyan brgyas legs spras te// 'dab sdug chu skyes ge sar 'khyil ba'i rtser// drang srong rgyal po 'gying bag brjid pa'i sku// dpe byad mtshan rdzogs khyod la= /brtson pa'i tshul can zhabs gnyis brtan gshibs shing*// ri dwags rgyal po lta bur rnam 'gying brjid// zla rgyas sprin bral 'dra ba'i zhal mnga' ba// gzi 'od dpal gyis brgyan la= /phyag g.yas zab cing rgya che'i chos 'chad dang*// phyag g.yon phun tshogs yon tan klu shing steng*// 'gro ba'i sdig tshogs dri ma 'khrud byed chu// bdud rtsi'i ril ba 'dzin la= /thub chen bla ma'i mchod rten gtsug tor ni// 'jig rten don sgrub nor bu 'bar bas spras// mi 'phrog snying rje'i pags pas smad dkris shing*// tshangs spyod tshangs skud bcings la= /ma lus skye rgu'i re sbyin gter khyod ni// khyad par yul ljongs 'di yi snying po ste// sgos gyur bdag gi skyabs gcig dpal lags pas// nyin mtshan rtag tu rab gus dran par bgyid// ring nas mgon med dub par gyur pa bdag /de ring nas bzung khyod la skyabs mchi ste// rgyal ba'i spyod pa rgya chen spyad bgyi yi// kho bo'i bsam pa mkhyen par mdzod cig lha// rje btsun byams pa la bstod pa gnubs lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis sbyar ba'o//

//byams bstod dad pa'i me tog gong ni ri ti pa'i gzhung gi mjug tu yod pas blang bar bya'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
